canonical_title: OpenSSL: Buffer overflow in EVP_EncodeBlock() (CVE-2026-121481, CVSS 9.8)
description: A buffer overflow vulnerability was identified in OpenSSL's EVP_EncodeBlock() function and assigned CVE-2026-121481 with a CVSS score of 9.8. The issue has been disclosed on Hacker News and a corresponding pull request was opened in the OpenSSL repository to address it.

canonical_title: Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark
description: Researchers introduced a benchmark called NextUnit-Bench for prognostics and health management (PHM) that includes 24 public datasets split into 58 folds with held‑out units or operating conditions. They used large‑language‑model (LLM) coding agents to automatically generate a model for each new PHM task, testing the idea that generality can reside in the model‑building agent rather than the model itself.

canonical_title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
description: Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to automate the process of turning a simulation idea into a working application, including asset assembly, physics and rendering integration, and scene validation.

canonical_title: When AI Analysts Disagree: Agentic Multiverse Analysis and the Robustness of Empirical Research
description: The paper introduces an Agentic Multiverse Analysis (AMA) framework that makes the impact of dozens of analytical choices (“forks”) visible at scale. In a pilot study the authors deployed 150 autonomous AI coding agents to run variations of a single observational dataset and a set of research questions, demonstrating how the framework can systematically explore how conclusions change with different methodological decisions.
